# Module `crypto`

crypto - hash primitives (#195).

`sha256(data)` returns the SHA-256 (FIPS 180-4) digest of a byte buffer as a
lowercase hexadecimal String. It crosses the runtime's `__vyb_sha256_hex`
helper in `runtime/vyb_runtime.c`; the returned `String` owns its buffer as
a normal Vyb String.

VybOS uses this in place of its collision-unsafe FNV-1a `content_hash`
stand-in so the store gets collision-safe content addressing.

Usage:
  import crypto::{sha256}
  println(sha256(""))  # e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855
